Exercise: Bodyweight Squat

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_lower_body_push

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
aerobic and anaerobic

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- overall_lower_body_strength_improvement
- hamstrings_engagement
- glutes_activation
- quadriceps_development

Contraindications:

- condition: knee injury, reason: can exacerbate knee issues if not performed correctly

Exercise Variations:

- name: Jump Squats, description: Add explosive power to the exercise for increased intensity
- name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Squat, description: Focuses on unilateral strength and balance

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Bodyweight Lunges, reason: targets similar muscles with a different movement pattern

Instructions:

- Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. You can place your hands behind your head. This will be your starting position.
- Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips.
- Continue down to full depth if you are able,and quickly reverse the motion until you return to the starting position. As you squat, keep your head and chest up and push your knees out.
